title: 밴 외부와 내부
purpose: Full original easy instance partitioned between two actors; no puzzle/entity omission.

rules.goal: Complete the original escape mechanism together.
rules.navigation: One move to any owned scene reachable in the original visible scene graph from its start. Free traversal is collapsed; original gates remain.
rules.communication: Explicit free-text send only; source papers remain transferable tools.
rules.hatch: Pass held tools from any area.
rules.environmental_links: Original cross-room mechanical unlocks are retained and audited.
rules.scheduling: Explicit actor, no model or budget scheduler.

scenes.name: van in dessert
scenes.desc: There is a van in the middle of the dessert, the scenario around it is very dry and wild.

scenes.name: back of the van
scenes.desc: There is a stepladder on the back but is currently folded underneath. There seems to be something on the top but you couldn't reach it.

scenes.name: underneath part of the van
scenes.desc: There is a stepladder on the right side. There is a license plate on the left side.

scenes.name: top of the van
scenes.desc: There is a spotlight on the top, with a cable connected to it. The other end of the cable goes into the car. Beside the spotlight, there's a skylight in the near front.

scenes.name: trunk of the van
scenes.desc: The trunk has a white door. The door seems not locked. There are some decorations beside the door.

scenes.name: repair kit in the trunk
scenes.desc: There is a blue repair kit box in the middle.

scenes.name: door of the van
scenes.desc: The door is locked. There is a window on the left side, and some mud below the window.

scenes.name: van indoor front overview
scenes.desc: The front of the van is spacious. There is a seat on the left side, and a comfortable passenger seat on the right side. There's a front desk before the left seat.

scenes.name: front desk
scenes.desc: There's a seat behind the desk on the left, a book shelf on the top, and a computer screen in the middle of desk.

scenes.name: book shelf
scenes.desc: The book shelf is full of books, with names "Ally 1", "Hunter 6", "Harper 3", "Violet 7", "Samuel 5", "Michael 2", "Victoria 4", "Brayden 8", "Liam 9", might have some special connection between the name and the number digits.

scenes.name: computer on the desk
scenes.desc: There's a seat behind the desk on the left, a book shelf on the top, and a computer screen in the middle of desk.

scenes.name: passage way in van
scenes.desc: There are some shelfs on the left top, currently closed. There's a microwave on the left on the table. There are some drawers below, and the bed is in front of you.

scenes.name: drawers
scenes.desc: Two drawer are under the table in passage way, each has a lock on it.

scenes.name: bed overview
scenes.desc: The bed is very messy, with a torch and a hat on it. There are shelves on the top, right and left side.

scenes.name: right side of bed
scenes.desc: A wall is on the right side of bed, a board on the wall.

scenes.name: bed shelf inside
scenes.desc: There's a bunch of things inside the shelf
